summary.tagline: Andøya (Norwegian), Ánda (Northern Sami), or Ánddasuolu (Northern Sami) is the northernmost island in the Vest

days.title: Northern Hub and Space Research
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Andenes
stops.detail: At the northern tip of the island lies Andenes, the administrative center of Andøy.

stops.name: Andenes fyr
stops.detail: The waters around the island are marked by two lighthouses: the Andenes fyr in the port of Andenes in the north of the island and the Anda fyr on the offshore island of Anden to the southwest.

stops.name: Andøya Spaceport
stops.detail: At Oksebasis, a rocket launch site known as the Andøya Spaceport (formerly Andøya Rocket Range), there are research stations that study the aurora and the atmosphere, and an observatory that explores the atmosphere with a particularly powerful laser beam.

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Central Geology and Iron Age History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ramsåfeltet
stops.detail: The coal deposits in the Ramsåfeltet fell form a geological specialty.

stops.name: Åse
stops.detail: In the village of Åse, about 40 km south of Andenes, a ring wall system from the early Iron Age has been excavated, which, alongside Engeløya and Borg, was another seat of power for Hålogaland chiefs.

days.title: Southeastern Gate to the Mainland
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Risøyhamn
stops.detail: The bridge spans the Risøysund at the village of Risøyhamn in the southeast; the Hurtigruten ships also call at port there.

stops.name: Andøybrua
stops.detail: Andøya is connected to Hinnøya and thus to the mainland via the Andøybrua bridge on Fylkesvei 82.
